name: Zaynara + Fafá de Belém
description: Zaynara and Fafá de Belém perform as part of the Festival Floresta Amazónica. Zaynara presents a blend of carimbó, Amazonian popular music, and contemporary urban sounds, while Fafá de Belém, with over five decades in music, performs Brazilian classics and works connected to Amazonian cultural identity.
longDescription:
Zaynara and Fafá de Belém are scheduled to perform at Casa da Música in Porto on November 15, 2026, starting at 20:30 in Sala Suggia. This event is part of the Festival Floresta Amazónica.

Zaynara, representing a new generation of Amazonian artists, combines influences from carimbó, Amazonian popular music, and contemporary urban sounds. Fafá de Belém, a renowned Brazilian artist from Belém do Pará, has a career spanning over five decades and is known for her distinctive voice and powerful interpretations of Brazilian classics and Amazonian cultural music.

Tickets for the concert range from €26.00 to €30.00. The doors to the hall open 30 minutes before the show, and late entry is not permitted once the performance begins, except during intervals or as indicated by staff. The venue is located at Avenida da Boavista, 604-610, 4149-071 Porto.

Os bilhetes para o concerto variam entre 26,00€ e 30,00€.
